limitations.quote: I’ll keep the registered beverage timing
limitations.note: The defect was the registered output decode: all three outputs should respond combinationally to the current state, selection, and active-low reset, but the rewrite still updates them on the rising edge.
The test generated its expected outputs from the rewrite’s own credit model and never changed selection between clock edges to check whether the outputs responded immediately.
Two simulation attempts failed before Icarus ran—first because of the cleanup command, then because the generated shell argument was too long—requiring a third attempt.

limitations.note: The knowledge-base index pointed to a branch for converting clocked outputs to a combinational state decode, but the agent did not open it.
